note: Ana is leaving for the mall. Luis asks her destination. They then talk about a man going to the bank and a woman going to the library. Finally, Ana’s family joins her: we are going to the mall, while an outside observer describes the same group as they. Every question is followed by the answer it requests. Teach present movement/destination, not be going to + verb for future plans. I go to school by bus describes a routine; I am going to the mall describes the current trip. Going was not found as a declared vocabulary target in the current catalog. Question patterns require exact contextual bindings. Do not call their familiar answer language additional new vocabulary.

lesson.title: 6.3 Where Are You Going?
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
lesson.goal: Ask about a current destination and answer with I am, you are, he/she is and we/they are going.
